content.text:
`slugify` is now implemented in `src/strings.js`, and `npm test` passes all 12 tests (2 existing, 10 new).

It lowercases the text and maps `đ` to `d`. It then strips diacritics and turns each run of non-`[a-z0-9]` characters into one hyphen. After trimming leading and trailing hyphens, it cuts to 50 characters and removes any hyphen the cut leaves at the end.

The new tests in `test/strings.test.js` cover these cases:
- basic lowercasing and hyphenation
- Vietnamese and other Latin diacritics
- `đ` and `Đ`
- collapsing runs of symbols
- trimming edge hyphens
- digits
- empty or symbol-only input
- the 50-character cut, including one where it would land on a hyphen
